title: 第一百三十九章 龙魂第一百三十八章 青龙精血
content_zh:
第一百三十九章龙魂
可就在龙魂冲向魂印的刹那，天坑之中，数万根纤细锋锐的金丝，朝着龙魂穿刺而来。此刻的龙魂只是魂体状态，并无实体龙鳞护体，根本抵挡不住这数万金丝的攻击。
转瞬之间，数万金丝毫无阻碍地刺穿龙魂，随即飞速缠绕，将龙魂死死捆住。原本撞向魂印的龙魂，被金丝巨大的拉扯之力硬生生拽住，悬停在虚空之中。
受制的龙魂发出一声狂怒的龙吼，咆哮道：“小辈，你敢算计本神，就要做好身死道消的准备。”
就在龙魂被金丝捆住之际，秦枫右手指尖一弹，一枚符咒直袭龙魂。
龙魂见状当即探出龙爪凌空一点，魂力飞速汇聚，凝出一面魂盾阻拦符咒的攻击。可符咒竟无视魂盾的防御，径直穿过魂盾，钻入龙魂体内。
龙魂满脸难以置信，惊愕道：“无视魂力防御，专攻魂体的符咒！小辈，你给了我太多的意外。等会，我定要彻底搜查你的神魂，将你身上所有隐藏的秘密挖出！”
说完，龙魂低声诵念起音节诡谲、晦涩古老的怪异咒语。龙魂体内大量精纯的魂力快速汇聚，飞速凝结成一枚枚奇异的符文，全力压制侵入体内的符咒，硬生生将符咒困在狭小的区域，令其无法继续扩散。
就在龙魂全力压制符咒扩散之时，虚空中的魂印已至龙魂头顶，镇压之力倾泻而下。龙魂无路可退，只得高昂龙首，以自身魂体硬扛魂印下坠的恐怖镇压之力。
而此时，那些缠绕、刺入龙魂体内的金丝，开始疯狂吞噬龙魂体内的魂力，其魂力飞速流失。
龙魂惊怒道：“好阴狠的手段，这些金丝竟暗藏吞噬法则！”
数万金丝贪婪的吞噬着龙魂体内的魂力，其魂力正以肉眼可见的速度飞速流失，原本百丈之巨的龙魂虚影，正一寸寸缩小。
此刻龙魂上有魂印镇压，体内又要压制符咒扩散，再加上金丝蛛金丝的捆绑与对魂力的吞噬，纵使它是上古青龙精血诞生的龙魂，也渐渐显露出难以支撑的颓势。
魂印持续向下镇压，龙魂随着魂力的不断减弱，身形的不断缩小，渐渐的抵挡不住魂印的镇压之力，龙魂开始缓缓下坠。
这时龙魂开始惊慌，急忙开口道：“小友，万事好商量，何必赶尽杀绝！”
此时的秦枫同样不好受，他施展符咒、操控金丝蛛，又最大限度的催动六道轮回印，体内魂力早已消耗大半，识海阵阵刺痛。
可他心中清楚，龙族统御万妖，此刻正是斩杀龙魂的最佳机会，若是心慈手软放龙魂离去，到时死无葬身之地的定会是自己。
杀机一闪即逝，秦枫心中只有一个念头，趁它病要他命，永除后患。
随着金丝对龙魂魂力的不断吞噬，龙魂虚影持续缩小，从百丈缩减至八十丈、七十丈，最终缩小到六十丈上下。
此时龙魂已彻底失去抗衡魂印镇压与压制符咒扩散的能力，魂印碾压而下。只听一声凄厉的龙吼，庞大的龙魂瞬间崩解，化作细碎的莹光消散。

龙魂体内的符咒却并未随之散去，而是万千符纹收拢归一，凝成一道纤细的银白光丝，一闪之下遁入虚无，不知所踪。
随着龙魂的消散，虚空中只剩下一滴血光璀璨的青龙精血，散发着浩瀚的龙威。
第一百三十九章龙魂
在旁护法的老祖见状，立刻上前，取出一枚温润的丹药递至秦枫身前。
秦枫此刻识海临近枯竭，没有半点迟疑，抬手接过丹药送入口中。丹药入口即化，一股温润的精纯魂力，顺着经脉快速补充几近枯竭的识海。识海的魂力快速充盈，刺痛的识海这才有所舒缓，紊乱的气息也渐渐平复下来。
老祖眼中是难以掩饰的担忧，轻声问道：“枫儿，可有大碍？”
秦枫轻声回道：“老祖，只是魂力透支严重，需闭关静养一段时日才能完全恢复。”
老祖闻言松了口气，开口道：“没事就好。”
秦枫看向虚空中那滴青龙精血，开口道：“老祖，我隐隐感觉到，这滴青龙精血对我炼体可能有巨大的裨益。”
老祖毫不在意地摆了摆手：“枫儿，不过一滴精血而已，你尽管拿去便是。”
“多谢老祖成全。”秦枫谢过老祖后，当即取出一只小玉瓶，以灵力牵引精血，将其收入小玉瓶中封存。随后他抬手凌空一召，天坑内的金丝蛛迅速缩小，最终化作一道金光，被收入储物戒中。
老祖亦抬手一挥，三百六十杆阵旗破空飞来，尽数收入随身的储物袋，神色凝重地开口道：“枫儿，此番大战虽有大阵遮蔽，可方才动静太大，定然会引来不少有心人的窥探，此地已不宜久留。”
二人不再多言，当即化作二道遁光，转瞬便消失在群山之间。
睢州南部，一座巨峰崖壁开凿出的一间石屋内，老祖与秦枫分坐于一粗糙的石桌旁，悠然的品偿着秦枫自颖州带来的春乐茶。
这时老祖开口道：“枫儿，一个月的时间，你我二人的伤势以完全恢复。以你如今的战力，只要行事谨慎，不生轻敌之心，这一方天地之内，以无人能对你形成威胁。”
老祖继续道：“仙宗与海妖联盟还有些事情需要我去处理，往后一段时间，我不能再护你修行了，切记万事以自身安危为重。”
秦枫注视着老祖说道：“老祖，往后遇到棘手的事情，千万不要独自硬扛。别忘了我与大哥，如今以有能力替您分忧了。”
老祖微笑着点头道：“枫儿，若是真到了需要你与翊儿出手时，我自会传讯于你。”
说完，老祖随手一挥，十只白玉小瓶凭空浮现，整齐的摆放在石桌之上。
老祖说道：“枫儿，这些是我平日闲暇之时，随手炼制的淬体药液，在关键时刻，可能会派上些许用场。”

秦枫道：“老祖，这段时间，我已收集了不少炼制淬体药液的灵药，准备自己偿试炼制淬体药液。”
老祖听罢哈哈大笑道：“枫儿，你开始与老祖客气了。”
秦枫正要出言解释，老祖却抬手凌空一划，虚空被撕裂一道丈许高的裂隙。老祖长笑一声，起身一步踏入裂隙之中，身影瞬间消失，虚空裂隙也随之缓缓合拢。
老祖离去后，秦枫平复了一下心境，开口道：“师兄，接下来我打算继续闭关，劳烦师兄替我护法。”
雪林君自石壁中穿梭而出，开口道：“主人放心，有我在，绝不会让任何人干扰主人修炼。”

Chapter 139 Dragon Soul
But at the moment when the dragon soul rushed towards the soul seal, tens of thousands of slender and sharp golden threads pierced towards the dragon soul in the sinkhole. The dragon soul at this moment is only in the state of soul body, without physical dragon scale protection, and cannot withstand the attack of tens of thousands of golden threads.
In the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of golden threads pierced the dragon soul without any hindrance, and then wrapped around it quickly, binding the dragon soul tightly. The dragon soul that originally crashed into the soul seal was grabbed by the huge pulling force of the golden thread and hovered in the void.
The controlled dragon soul let out a furious dragon roar and roared: "Junior, if you dare to plot against me, you must be prepared to die."
Just when the dragon soul was bound by the golden thread, Qin Feng flicked the fingertips of his right hand, and a spell hit the dragon soul directly.
Upon seeing this, the dragon soul immediately stretched out its dragon claws a little in the air, gathered its soul power quickly, and formed a soul shield to block the spell's attack. But the talisman ignored the soul shield's defense and went straight through the soul shield and into the dragon soul.
Dragon Soul's face was full of disbelief, and he said in shock: "Ignore the soul defense and specialize in the soul body's spells! Junior, you have given me too many surprises. Later, I will thoroughly search your soul and dig out all the hidden secrets in you!"
After saying that, the dragon soul recited a strange, obscure and ancient spell in a low voice with strange syllables. A large amount of pure soul power in the dragon soul quickly gathered and quickly condensed into strange runes. It tried its best to suppress the spells that invaded the body, and forcibly trapped the spells in a small area, preventing them from spreading further.
Just when the dragon soul was trying its best to suppress the spread of the spell, the soul seal in the void had reached the top of the dragon soul's head, and the suppressive power poured down. The dragon soul had no way to retreat, so it had no choice but to hold its head high and use its own soul body to bear the terrifying suppressive force of the falling soul mark.
At this time, those golden threads entangled and pierced into the dragon soul began to crazily devour the soul power in the dragon soul, and its soul power was lost rapidly.
Dragon Soul said in shock and anger: "What a cruel method, these golden threads actually hide the law of devouring!"
Tens of thousands of golden threads greedily devoured the soul power in the dragon soul, and its soul power was rapidly being lost at a speed visible to the naked eye. The shadow of the dragon soul, which was originally a hundred feet in size, was shrinking inch by inch.
At this moment, there are soul seals on the dragon soul to suppress it, and the spread of suppressive talismans within the body, plus the binding of the golden spider's golden threads and the devouring of the soul power, even though it is a dragon soul born from the essence and blood of the ancient green dragon, it is gradually showing an unsustainable decline.
The soul seal continued to suppress downwards. As the soul power continued to weaken, the dragon soul continued to shrink, and gradually it could not withstand the suppressive power of the soul seal, and the dragon soul began to slowly fall.
At this time, the dragon soul began to panic and hurriedly said: "Little friend, everything is easy to discuss, why bother to kill them all!"
At this time, Qin Feng was also feeling uncomfortable. He cast spells, controlled the golden silk spider, and activated the six reincarnation seals to the maximum extent. Most of the soul power in his body had been consumed, and the sea of consciousness was tingling.
But he knew in his heart that the dragon clan controlled all the monsters, and now was the best opportunity to kill the dragon soul. If he was merciful and let the dragon soul leave, he would definitely be the one who died without a burial place.
The murderous intention was fleeting, and Qin Feng had only one thought in his mind: to kill him while he was sick, and to eliminate future troubles forever.
As the golden thread continued to devour the soul power of the dragon soul, the shadow of the dragon soul continued to shrink, shrinking from a hundred feet to eighty feet, seventy feet, and finally to about sixty feet.
At this time, the dragon soul had completely lost its ability to resist the suppression of the soul seal and the spread of the suppression spell, and the soul seal crushed down. Just hearing a shrill dragon roar, the huge dragon soul instantly disintegrated, turning into tiny pieces of light and dissipating.
However, the talismans within the dragon soul did not dissipate. Instead, thousands of talisman patterns gathered together and condensed into a slender silver-white light, which disappeared into nothingness in a blink of an eye.
As the dragon soul dissipated, only a drop of bright blue dragon essence and blood remained in the void, exuding vast dragon power.
Chapter 139 Dragon Soul
Upon seeing this, the ancestor who was protecting the law immediately stepped forward, took out a warm elixir and handed it to Qin Feng.At this moment, Qin Feng's sea of ​​consciousness was close to drying up. Without any hesitation, he raised his hand to take the elixir and put it into his mouth. The elixir melts instantly in the mouth, and a warm and pure soul power quickly replenishes the nearly exhausted sea of ​​consciousness along the meridians. The soul power of the sea of ​​​​consciousness quickly filled up, and the tingling sea of ​​​​consciousness was relieved, and the chaotic breath gradually calmed down.
There was unconcealable worry in the ancestor's eyes, and he asked softly: "Feng'er, is there something serious?"
Qin Feng replied softly: "Ancestor, your soul power is seriously overdrawn, and you need to retreat for a period of time to fully recover."
The ancestor breathed a sigh of relief when he heard this and said, "It's just fine."
Qin Feng looked at the drop of Azure Dragon Essence and Blood in the void and said, "Ancestor, I have a vague feeling that this drop of Azure Dragon Essence and Blood may be of great benefit to my body refinement."
The ancestor waved his hand indifferently: "Feng'er, it's just a drop of blood essence, just take it."
"Thank you, ancestor." After Qin Feng thanked his ancestor, he immediately took out a small jade bottle, used his spiritual power to draw the blood essence, and put it into the small jade bottle to seal it. Then he raised his hand and called in the air, and the golden silk spider in the sinkhole quickly shrank, and finally turned into a golden light and was stored in the storage ring.
The ancestor also raised his hand and waved, and three hundred and sixty formation flags flew through the air. He put them all into his storage bag and said solemnly: "Feng'er, although this battle is covered by a large formation, there was too much movement just now, which will definitely attract a lot of prying eyes from interested people. It is no longer suitable to stay here for a long time."
The two of them said nothing more, and immediately turned into two rays of light, disappearing among the mountains in an instant.
In the southern part of Suizhou, in a stone house carved out of the cliff of a giant peak, the ancestor and Qin Feng sat at a rough stone table, leisurely sipping the Chunle tea that Qin Feng brought from Yingzhou.
At this time, the ancestor said: "Feng'er, within a month, you and I will be fully recovered from our injuries. With your current combat power, as long as you act cautiously and don't underestimate the enemy, no one in this world can pose a threat to you."
The ancestor continued: "The Immortal Sect and the Siren Alliance still have some matters that I need to deal with. In the future, I will no longer be able to protect you in your practice. Remember to put your own safety first in everything."
Qin Feng looked at the ancestor and said: "Ancestor, if you encounter difficult things in the future, never bear it alone. Don't forget that eldest brother and I are now capable of sharing your worries."
The ancestor smiled and nodded: "Feng'er, if it comes time for you and Yi'er to take action, I will send you a message."
After speaking, the ancestor waved his hand, and ten white jade vials appeared out of thin air and were placed neatly on the stone table.
The ancestor said: "Feng'er, these are the body-tempering liquids that I refine in my spare time. They may come in handy at critical moments."
Qin Feng said: "Ancestor, during this period of time, I have collected a lot of elixirs for refining the body tempering liquid, and I am preparing to refining the body tempering liquid myself."
After hearing this, the ancestor laughed and said: "Feng'er, you are starting to be polite to the ancestor."
Qin Feng was about to explain, but the ancestor raised his hand and swiped in the air, and a crack of about ten feet high was torn into the void. The ancestor laughed, stood up and stepped into the crack. His figure disappeared instantly, and the void crack slowly closed.
After the ancestor left, Qin Feng calmed down and said: "Senior brother, I plan to continue to retreat, please help me protect the law."
Lord Xue Lin walked out of the stone wall and said, "Master, don't worry, as long as I am here, I will never let anyone interfere with your master's cultivation."
